subject.title: fix(memory-core): defer dreaming sweep when main session has active runs

question: Should this PR remain a mitigation-only scheduling change, or must it first prove and prevent overlap for the entire dreaming sweep on current main?
rationale: The linked issue’s current review says the complete failure chain is unproven, while the patch’s one-time count still permits foreground work to start after admission.

options.title: Require full overlap prevention
options.body: Replace the one-time check with an atomic or yieldable foreground-priority admission boundary and require real concurrent proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Land the preflight-only deferral with explicit acceptance that overlap can still begin after the check and unrelated activity can starve dreaming.

recommendation.title: Require full overlap prevention
recommendation.body: Replace the one-time check with an atomic or yieldable foreground-priority admission boundary and require real concurrent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work ties this person to both embedded run-state and the session-fence owner boundary that must be distinguished from provider contention.
